fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled Android app.
fields.label: App title
fields.what: The public name shown in the Google Play listing for this locale.
fields.why: A localized title helps people recognize the intended app.
fields.where: Use the approved public app name, localized by your content owner.
fields.format: UTF-8 plain text. The shared core checks the 30-character Store limit. Raw line endings and whitespace are saved exactly as reviewed.
fields.failure: Empty text, placeholders, possible secrets or an excessive title block this text save. This is not Store approval.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled Android app.
fields.label: Short description
fields.what: A short public summary of the Android app.
fields.why: It tells people the primary benefit of the app before they read the full listing.
fields.where: Write or obtain approved localized public marketing copy.
fields.format: UTF-8 plain text. The shared core checks the 80-character Store limit; it does not translate or rewrite your text.
fields.failure: Missing or format-invalid text blocks this text save. Keep credentials and private review instructions out of public copy.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled Android app.
fields.label: Full description
fields.what: The full public Android app description for this locale.
fields.why: It explains supported features and expectations to prospective users.
fields.where: Use the current approved public product description and a reviewed localization.
fields.format: UTF-8 plain text with a shared-core 4000-character limit. Validation uses the existing generic newline-counting policy; Save preserves the exact reviewed bytes.
fields.failure: Empty content, unresolved placeholders, possible secrets or excess length block this save. Android changelog and build selection are separate.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled iOS app.
fields.label: App description
fields.what: The public App Store description for this locale.
fields.why: It describes what the released app offers to users.
fields.where: Use the approved public product description and a reviewed localization.
fields.format: UTF-8 plain text with a shared-core 4000-character limit. This editor does not modify categories or optional app-information fields.
fields.failure: Missing or format-invalid public text blocks this save. Private review contacts, demo credentials and TestFlight instructions do not belong here.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled iOS app.
fields.label: Keywords
fields.what: The public search keywords supplied for the iOS listing.
fields.why: Approved localized keywords help relevant users find the app.
fields.where: Obtain the intended keyword list from the public listing owner.
fields.format: UTF-8 text, typically comma-separated keywords. The shared core checks the existing 100-character limit, not search ranking or Store acceptance.
fields.failure: Empty, placeholder, secret-like or overly long text blocks this save. No keyword generation or automatic translation is performed.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled iOS app.
fields.label: Privacy policy URL
fields.what: The public HTTPS address of the app's privacy policy.
fields.why: Users need an accessible statement of the app's data practices.
fields.where: Ask the app owner for the approved public privacy-policy page for this locale.
fields.format: An absolute credential-free HTTPS URL, no query or fragment, within the shared core's 2048-character URL bound. The page is not contacted.
fields.failure: Malformed URLs, surrounding whitespace, placeholders or possible secrets block this save. Format validity does not establish reachability or legal adequacy.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled iOS app.
fields.label: Support URL
fields.what: The public HTTPS support page for the app.
fields.why: Users need a public place to obtain support.
fields.where: Use the app owner's approved support page for this locale, not a signed or authenticated private link.
fields.format: An absolute credential-free HTTPS URL, no query or fragment, within the shared core's 2048-character URL bound. Validation does not visit the page.
fields.failure: Invalid or secret-bearing URLs block this save. This does not verify support availability or Store acceptance.

fields.requiredWhen: Each configured locale of an enabled iOS app.
fields.label: Public release notes
fields.what: The public iOS release notes shown to users for the release.
fields.why: Users should understand the changes in the version they receive.
fields.where: Use the approved user-facing change summary and a reviewed localization.
fields.format: UTF-8 plain text with a shared-core 4000-character limit. These are public notes, not private TestFlight what-to-test or App Review instructions.
fields.failure: Empty text, unresolved placeholders, possible secrets or excess length block this save. No build, upload or release operation is performed.

actions.requiredWhen: Before reviewing one enabled platform and locale from the saved configuration.
actions.label: Load saved text
actions.what: Read only the known public text files for this selection.
actions.why: A fresh bounded observation gives this draft a comparison baseline without scanning private metadata.
actions.where: Choose an enabled platform and a locale already saved in project configuration. Save root or locale configuration changes separately first.
actions.format: Missing known files are shown as absent. Unsafe, changed, oversized, unreadable, non-UTF-8 or possible-secret files return no text result.
actions.failure: Loading is non-atomic and cannot authorize a later write. Dirty drafts are retained; unavailable browser or native services do not supply successful fixture text.

actions.requiredWhen: After editing the selected locale's public text bundle.
actions.label: Validate text
actions.what: Ask the shared core to check the supplied text without reading or writing project files.
actions.why: The CLI and desktop use the same generic empty, NUL, placeholder, secret, URL and character-limit policy.
actions.where: Use the validation action after supplying every required field for the selected platform.
actions.format: Core counts use universal-newline conversion and remove trailing LF only for validation. Draft and saved payload bytes are not normalized.
actions.failure: Invalid text must be corrected before preparing a save. Format-valid does not mean translated, legally reviewed, Store-accepted or release-ready.

actions.requiredWhen: Before an app-managed save when the qualified native edit service is available.
actions.label: Review text save
actions.what: Capture an original typed edit and preview the exact create, replace or preserve actions.
actions.why: The original saved configuration fixes the writable roster; a renderer path or baseline cannot grant filesystem authority.
actions.where: Review each path, before and after content, raw line-ending changes and new target directories in the prepared view.
actions.format: One platform and locale per operation. Configuration and .gitignore are read-only dependencies; safe ignore coverage must already exist.
actions.failure: Stale observations, changed configuration, pending state or insufficient ignore coverage refuse preparation. Correct configuration separately; do not retry a possibly submitted save.

actions.requiredWhen: Only after reviewing an all-valid original prepared plan and when the native metadata edit gate is qualified.
actions.label: Save reviewed text
actions.what: Submit the original one-use plan to the app-managed local transaction.
actions.why: A settled original owner keeps exact-byte creation, replacement, rollback and cleanup facts distinct.
actions.where: Use Save on the prepared review, never an arbitrary path writer or manual command fallback.
actions.format: Only the selected public text bundle may change. No configuration, ignore rules, screenshots, private notes, Git, Store or release operation is written or executed.
actions.failure: A timeout or lost reply is not proof of success or failure. Observe the original owner, preserve the draft, and require settled finality; source presence alone does not enable this gate.

actions.requiredWhen: When you decide not to use a local draft or an unsubmitted prepared review.
actions.label: Discard draft or review
actions.what: Explicitly retire local draft or unsubmitted review state.
actions.why: Changing a tab, locale or project must not silently erase unsaved work.
actions.where: Use the explicit discard action for the selected draft or close an unsubmitted review.
actions.format: Discarding in-memory authority performs no transaction cleanup. Already-submitted Apply must settle through its original owner.
actions.failure: Do not infer cancellation, rollback or cleanup from closing a view. Unknown outcomes preserve the reviewed draft and original status.
